verdict.rationale: RUN documents paying employees who work in more than one state or local jurisdiction in the same pay period, with ADP handling the tax filing. It also calculates, files and pays payroll taxes, manages state unemployment insurance including SUI rate audits, and backs its tax filings with a penalty guarantee. missing for 10: evidence that RUN handles state tax account registrations for new states, detail on per-state withholding setup, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state accuracy.
